yt_title: That happy customer in the ad might not be real

fx.hook: HOW TO SPOT ONE: AT THE END

caption:
That happy customer in the ad might not be real.

A saved reel showed how fast AI makes ads with AI actors. Making ads with AI is fine.
Presenting an AI actor as a real customer is a fake testimonial. That's misleading.

The honest version:
Use AI for the script and the visuals
Use real reviews from real customers
Label AI people as AI

Sorted by SaveSort. Sort your saves free, link in bio.

#marketing #ads #aitools #scamwatch
